title: UI: Ensure Link without href is keyboard-reachable
body: ## What I did Tied the `isButton` logic of the `Link` component to the absence of a `href`. Without a `href`, an HTML anchor will not be keyboard-reachable. This implies buttons that use the `Link` styling with ` ... } />` are not accessible. As all our usages of ` #### The changes in this PR are covered in the following automated tests: - [x] stories - [ ] unit tests - [ ] integration tests - [ ] end-to-end tests #### Manual testing 1. Visit http://localhost:6006/?path=/settings/guide 2. Try to focus the little link at the bottom of all the accordions ### 🦋 Canary release This PR does not have a canary release associated. You can request a canary release of this pull request by mentioning the `@storybookjs/core` team here. _core team members can create a canary release [here](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/actions/workflows/publish.yml) or locally with `gh workflow run --repo storybookjs/storybook publish.yml --field pr=`_ ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Documentation** * Added ariaLabel guidance for popovers and modals, noted deprecation of the Link isButton prop, and minor formatting fixes. * **Improvements** * Enhanced Link button styling for focus and accessibility. * Several previously button-styled links now display as standard links while preserving click behavior. * **Tests / Stories** * Stories updated to typed format with an interactive link test; e2e tests adjusted selectors to match element type changes.

**Set an explicit button type for the no-`href` path.**

When `href` is missing (lines 220–225), the component renders a real `<button>` element. Without an explicit `type` attribute, HTML defaults to `type="submit"`, which can cause unintended form submissions if the Link is used within a form.

Real usages exist in the codebase (e.g., `GuidePage.tsx`, `UpgradeBlock.tsx`) where `Link` is called without `href`, triggering button rendering. The codebase's other button-based components consistently use explicit `type="button"`.

<details>
<summary>Suggested patch</summary>

```diff
       <A
         as={href ? 'a' : 'button'}
         href={href}
+        type={href ? undefined : 'button'}
         {...rest}
         ref={ref}
         isButton={!href || isButton === true}
         onClick={onClick && cancel ? (e) => cancelled(e, onClick) : onClick}
         className={className}
       >
```
</details>

**Improve clarity of `href` presence check using explicit null/undefined comparison.**

Lines 221 and 225 use truthiness checks on `href`, which would treat an empty string `href=""` as falsy and switch to button behavior. Since the type definition allows `href?: string`, use `href != null` to explicitly check for the absence of the prop rather than relying on truthiness.

<details>
<summary>Suggested patch</summary>

```diff
+    const hasHref = href != null;
     return (
       <A
-        as={href ? 'a' : 'button'}
+        as={hasHref ? 'a' : 'button'}
         href={href}
         {...rest}
         ref={ref}
-        isButton={!href || isButton === true}
+        isButton={!hasHref || isButton === true}
         onClick={onClick && cancel ? (e) => cancelled(e, onClick) : onClick}
         className={className}
       >
```
</details>

<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>
